indices: zero-based (row,column); row zero at top, column zero at left
start_definition: Clockwise quarter-turn count from supplied mask; direction applies to subsequent turns
signature: encrypt(payload, *, side, holes, start_quarters=0, direction="clockwise", hole_scan="row-major", cipher_serialization="row-major") -> str; decrypt(ciphertext, same keyword arguments) -> str
other_public_methods: validate_key(side, holes) -> immutable sorted tuple of holes
settings_route(*, same keyword arguments) -> tuple of payload-visit coordinates
side: even integer at least two; bool excluded
holes: one exact hole per four-cell orbit; all four orientations cover all cells once
literal_extent: nonempty str with len(str) a positive exact multiple of side squared; Unicode codepoints are never normalized, stripped, filtered or padded
fixtures: KNOWN_VECTORS_v1.json and SYNTHETIC_REPRESENTATIVE_VECTORS_v1.json contain literal generic data only
controls_write_policy: Outputs are write-exclusive; retain registration/vectors and use a fresh directory for a rerun. No target auto-discovery or target file reading.
